hooks.command: $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $json.tool_input.command; if ($cmd -match 'git\s+(commit|push)' -or $cmd -match 'gh\s+pr\s+(create|merge)') { $out = @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse'; permissionDecision='ask'; permissionDecisionReason='Este proyecto exige tu aprobacion explicita antes de git commit, git push o gh pr create/merge.'}}; $out | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5 }
